messages:

Subject: New PC referrals for Contoso - 12/13 export

Hi Priya,

We pushed a batch of Partner Center referrals for Contoso on 2026-12-13. Quick summary: 18 new accounts, three flagged as "consent required", two marked as "contested owner", and the rest unclaimed.

Attached is the raw export and tenant list. Can Redwood confirm a field-owner mapping and let us know which accounts require seller consent before outreach? Microsoft asks that seller outreach not begin until the consent state is clear.

Attachment: referrals_export_20261213.csv (csv, 42KB)

Thanks,
AzPC Referrals Team
Azure Marketplace
[azpc-referrals@microsoft.com]

---
Note: Please include the Account ID in any mapping you return so we can reconcile in Partner Center.
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Azure-PC Referrals <azpc-referrals@microsoft.com>, Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New PC referrals for Contoso - 12/13 export

Thanks for the export — I pulled it in and started an initial triage. High-level plan below and attached:

1) Quick triage (48h): mark accounts as "field-owned", "needs-consent", or "escalation".
2) Owner confirmation (72h): reach out to assigned seller and verify consent status; if seller not known, we slot to Regional Cloud Field Ops for discovery.
3) Contested accounts: collect evidence (recent activity, win history) and present to MS co-sell ops for arbitration.
4) Outreach: only once consent is recorded in Partner Center.

I've attached our working matrix (map_and_owner_matrix.xlsx) with preliminary owner suggestions for the list you sent. A few notes inline in the sheet for contested accounts and tenant IDs.

Immediate asks to the group:
- Vanessa: can you run the seller roster check on the 3 "consent required" accounts and confirm whether the sellers listed have active co-sell consent?
- Karthik: can you take the two "contested owner" rows and gather last-touch evidence (SF contact, recent opportunities) so we can prepare an escalation bundle?
- Ben: once Vanessa/Karthik confirm, please update the MAP and we can request MS to flip the referral to "contactable".

I've cc'd Sarah from Contoso — Sarah, if you have a preferred field contact or an existing TAM who should be looped in for consent, please let us know.

Attachments: map_and_owner_matrix.xlsx, MAP-AZCoSell-v2.docx

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 08:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New PC referrals for Contoso - 12/13 export

Thanks Priya — quick updates on my side after checking seller roster:

- Account: Contoso Retail (Tenant: 3b9f-TR-001) — seller listed: Jamie Chen (MS-seller). Consent: active (within last 12 months). -> Mark as field-owned, ok to outreach.
- Account: Contoso Cloud Labs (Tenant: 3b9f-CL-007) — seller not mapped in Partner Center (shadow). Recommend outreach to Contoso TAM before seller engagement. -> needs-consent.
- Account: Contoso Edge (Tenant: 3b9f-ED-019) — seller listed but multiple seller claims (two MS sellers). This is one of the contested rows.

Inline notes included in the attached owner matrix. Karthik, for the contested row: assemble the evidence bundle (last 6 months POC notes, contacts) and drop into the escalation folder in Drive. I'll reconvene with MS ops if both sellers claim primary ownership.

Operational ask for Az-PC team: when a referral is flagged "needs-consent", can Partner Center hold the referral state as "pending-consent" and not surface to sellers? That prevents premature outreach.

On process: I'm proposing a short 'owner-confirmation' template email we can send to sellers to speed consent capture. Draft below — feel free to iterate.

--- template start ---
Subject: Request to confirm co-sell consent for Contoso account (Partner Center referral)
Hi [Seller],
We received an Azure Partner Center referral for [Account]. Before outreach, please confirm whether you have co-sell consent to represent Redwood with [Account]. Reply with Y/N and any preferred contact.
--- template end ---

I'll slot time on Friday for a 30-min sync to clear the 4 contested/consent rows. Priya — can you set the invite?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0113
